meaning_fixes.reason: Source 敌の親分はどこに？ explicitly asks for the ENEMY's boss/leader. Dropping 'enemy' creates a real ambiguity this speaker (Amuro, a soldier who has an actual chain of command) doesn't have in the source: 'Where's boss?' could be misread as asking after his own commanding officer rather than the enemy leader. 'Enemy's boss?' (13 chars) restores the referent and fits the 16-char budget (min(72, 2*9-2)).
